item.title: Captures: locked topic, filter checked, cross-category search, MP list logged out, reho.st images (#122, #134, #121)
item.body:
Closes #122
Closes #134
Closes #273
Refs #121
Refs #109
Refs #274

Claim: mac/m2-lead

Read-only capture batch (GET only, two logins, 38 requests). Captures: R122a-R122d (locked topic logged in, a favourite topic opened from an owntopic=1 row as user1, in-topic search with the filter box checked and unchecked), R121a-R121f (MP list logged out, global search across categories, search form page, logged-in category list, single-page list), T30-T33 (real reho.st images with and without Referer). Legacy oracles in `Fixtures/M2-readonly/` (own map: the LOT-002/003 guard tests list every case; wiring them is a follow-up). Facts in HFR-PROTOCOL §6c "M2 read-only captures", rows in MANIFEST.

- #273: no new capture, already served by R63a/R63e (own post on a public topic: edit cryptlink + "Edition rapide", quote, multi-quote, addflag, modo; no MP/contact link).
- #121: MP list logged out and cross-category search (pivot category 5) served; logged-in category list (cat 22) for the flag-link, sticky and single-page rows; rare row shapes searched (20 category lists, 3 search pages) and not found.
- #109: row without flag link, single-page and sticky rows are in R121e; the empty `owntopic=1` state needs a separate write batch.
- #274: not seen in 627 toolbar images of the corpus.
- #134: https and http reho.st images: 403 without Referer, 200 image/jpeg with it.

Checks: `anonymize.py check --corpus` and `check --config` clean, `swift test` green. Independent leak check (Opus, own patterns from the raw files plus operator names, ids, cookies and tokens) PASSED on head 0702fbca, and a delta check on 372aea05 (the later capture changes).

dev-swift (with #435) is merged here; the E26 row and the "reho.st images" line are updated. Known failing test: `HFRLinkRouteCorpusTests` on four real URL shapes of the new pages, tracked in #482. Wiring the new oracles: #475.

&cat=&config=hfr.inc&cache=&page=1&sondage=0&owntopic=0&word=&spseudo=&filter=1¤tnum=` (the `R52a` `Location` plus `filter=1`, no POST, no `hash_check`) answers 200 with the topic page restricted to the messages that contain the word: 31 messages in one piece, no pager, `word` prefilled and ``. Without `filter` the same URL is a normal page 1 (40 messages, pager) with `word` prefilled and the box unchecked. Whether the `transsearch.php` POST with `filter=1` answers the same 302 target plus `filter=1` is **not** captured (a POST: left to a run that may send one). +- **MP list logged out** (`R121a`, **verified**): `forum1.php?config=hfr.inc&cat=prive&page=1` without cookies answers 200 with a bare `` and the `.hop` "Désolé, vous ne faites pas partie des membres ayant accès à cette catégorie" plus a back link (no list, no refresh). A results GET with `cat=` (the `R50b` URL with the category emptied, no POST, no cookie) answers **302** to `/forum1.php?config=hfr.inc&cat=&post_cat_list=|14*hfr|5*hfr|…|&trash=0&orderSearch=0&recherches=1&resSearch=200&jour=0&mois=0&annee=0&titre=3&search=&pseud=&daterange=2&searchtype=1&searchall=1`. @@ -442,6 +442,19 @@ Source: [LOT-084](lots/LOT-084-reply-composer.md), `ReplyEntryTests` through `Li - **MP reply link** (`RA1`, **verified**): a conversation page's answer link is `/message.php?config=hfr.inc&cat=prive&post=&page=1&p=1&subcat=0&sondage=0&owntopic=0&new=0`, the URL of the MP reply composer `R47b`; its `cat` and `post` name the conversation. - **Pending capture**: a page past the last one of a `cat=prive` thread (`R24` is a public topic; the app never asks it after an MP reply); how `dest` separates several recipients and HFR's answer to an unknown pseudo; a `dest=` link for a pseudo with a space or a `+`. +### M2 read-only captures (#121, #122, #134, #109, 2026-11-05) + +Read-only GETs of `mac/m2-lead` (`R121a`-`R121f`, `R122a`-`R122d`, `T30`-`T33`); nothing was sent but the logins. Their legacy oracles (`R121a`, `R121b`, `R121c`, `R121e`, `R121f`, `R122a`-`R122d`) are in `Fixtures/M2-readonly/` with their own `oracle-map.json`, outside the LOT-002/LOT-003 maps whose guard tests list every case: no Swift test reads them yet. + +- **Locked topic, logged in** (`R122a`, **verified**): the page is a normal topic page with no way to answer: no `#repondre_form`, no bottom answer link, no `.hop` (as for the logged-out reader of `R31`). The per-message quote links stay (`quote.gif` "Répondre à ce message", the multi-quote `quote+.gif`/`quote-.gif` pair), and so does the header flag link (`delflag`, `flagn0.gif` for an account that only read the topic). A locked topic therefore keeps no `hop` for a logged-in account. +- **Flag link from a followed list** (`R122b`, **verified**): the topic row link of a `forum1f.php?owntopic=1` list carries `owntopic=1`; the page it opens (a favourite, user1) has the header `delflag` link with `owntopic=1&new=0` and `favorisn.gif`, and the in-topic search form's hidden `owntopic` is `1` (not `0` as on `R122a`/`R122c`). +- **In-topic search with the filter checked is a plain GET** (`R122c`, `R122d`, **verified**): `GET /forum2.php?post=

&cat=&config=hfr.inc&cache=&page=1&sondage=0&owntopic=0&word=&spseudo=&filter=1¤tnum=` (the `R52a` `Location` plus `filter=1`, no POST, no `hash_check`) answers 200 with the topic page restricted to the messages that contain the word: 31 messages in one piece, no pager, `word` prefilled and ``.
